title: bot.degraded
description: Error signal that the bot entered, or already sits in, its degraded lifecycle state. A bot is degraded when a lifecycle teardown could not finish inside its bound, so devices or abilities may still be running. It answers the lifecycle request it was serving with this terminal under that request's envelope id.

stage.description: Lifecycle stage whose bound expired: activation rollback cleanup, cancelling an activation, deactivation cleanup, reboot cleanup, or cancelling a processing turn. ``degraded`` answers a deactivation requested while the bot was already degraded.
stage.title: Stage
